448281.overview:
Explore the maze, hack all the computer terminals, and defeat the Hive Mind. Defeated enemies might drop weapon upgrades or health refills. Getting hit will downgrade your weapon.

X-Zero is a one-level PICO-8 platform shooter similar to Turrican.

448633.overview:
Be an X-Wing pilot!

Take a seat in the most advanced fighter of the galaxy. Fight against the evil empire! Use proton torpedo to quickly dismiss enemy forces or your 4 blasters (aiming skill required). Go through 4 epic missions, from space to Deathstar and back.

453294.overview: Defeat enemies or catch them to turn them back into presents.  Collect cookies to restore your health.  Try to reach the end with all the presents in the wishlist
